summary: US futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal, keeping geopolitical risk elevated. Strong April jobs report (115K vs 62K consensus) reinforced higher-for-longer rates. AI momentum remains intact with semiconductor giants leading, while oil fluctuates near $100/bbl and gold slips on inflation fears.

topNews.title: Trump Rejects Iran Peace Proposal - Geopolitical Risk Premiums Elevated
topNews.impact: Market uncertainty rises as hopes for US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough dimmed. Energy and defense sectors retain risk bid while ceasefire holds prevent major oil spike.
topNews.macroRisk: Yes - Geopolitical risk in Middle East affecting energy prices

topNews.title: Strong Jobs Report Reinforces Higher-for-Longer Rates
topNews.impact: April jobs data (115K actual vs 62K consensus) reduces Fed rate cut expectations for 2026, supporting elevated Treasury yields.
topNews.macroRisk: No - Bond market pressure from stronger employment data

topNews.title: AI Rally Expands Beyond Tech with Industrial AI Initiative
topNews.impact: Apple-Intel chip pact and Jeff Bezos's $10B industrial AI fund signal broadening AI capex beyond traditional tech giants.

topNews.title: Gold Falls 1% on Oil-Driven Inflation Fears
topNews.impact: Elevated oil prices near $100/bbl fuel inflation concerns, reducing gold appeal as investors favor real yields over safe-haven metals.
topNews.macroRisk: No - Inflation dynamics driving precious metals

topNews.title: China Yuan Strengthens Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
topNews.impact: PBOC's currency management keeps yuan at 3-year highs, setting stage for May 14-15 Beijing summit between US and Chinese leaders.

sectorRadar.ai: AI-driven equity rally remains intact. Apple-Intel chip pact and Jeff Bezos's industrial AI initiative signal broadening beyond traditional tech. Hyperscaler AI capex projected to top $1.1T.
sectorRadar.semiconductor: Semiconductor giants AMD and Micron lead market gains as AI hardware supercycle dominates. KOSPI crosses 7,000 driven by memory chip demand.
sectorRadar.bigTech: Broad tech strength despite market wobble. Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.02% while S&P 500 futures dip 0.2%. AI capex expansion supports large tech names.
sectorRadar.energy: Oil fluctuates near $100/bbl with upside risk from Middle East tensions. Energy sector retains risk bid despite ceasefire holding. Citi warns upward bias remains.
sectorRadar.ev: EV sector mixed amid high energy import costs for Asian markets. Korean automakers benefit from chip demand surge.
sectorRadar.market: US futures edge lower 0.2% in Asian session. S&P 500 recorded weekly gains with semiconductor strength. Nasdaq 100 faces resistance at 29,505/615 after steep rally.
sectorRadar.preciousMetals: Gold slips on inflation fears as oil-driven higher rates reduce safe-haven appeal. Gold holds below $4,775/oz 50-day moving average with China PBOC loading for 18th month.
sectorRadar.oil: Crude fluctuating near $100/bbl. Israel warns conflict with Iran not over. Trump's rejection of Iran terms keeps energy/defense sectors on risk bid despite ceasefire.

premarketFocus.futures: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran peace deal. Dow Jones futures little changed. Mixed sentiment post-weekly gains.
premarketFocus.treasury10Y: 30-year Treasury yield supported at 4.90% (50-day MA) due to strong jobs data. Bond market under pressure from 'higher-for-longer' rate narrative.
premarketFocus.dxy: Dollar stable as yuan strengthens and yen remains volatile. Japan's suspected $67B intervention keeps FX investors on edge.
premarketFocus.oil: Crude oil near $100/bbl with upside risk from Middle East tensions. Citi warns upward bias persists despite ceasefire.
premarketFocus.keyRisk: US-Iran diplomatic developments - Trump's 'unacceptable' designation keeps geopolitical risk premium elevated even as military engagements pause.

judgment.note: AI momentum and tech strength offset geopolitical headwinds from US-Iran tensions. Bond yields remain elevated post-strong jobs data. Oil's upward bias limits gold appeal. Favor selective positioning in AI leaders and energy, cautious on financials amid rate uncertainty.
